title: Cognotik Desktop – Plugin Installation
overview: A short demo walkthrough showing how to install a plugin in the Cognotik desktop application, including uploading the JAR file, accepting the license agreement, verifying Patreon subscription status, and seeing the new options appear on the home page.

finalStructure.description: Intro billboard: 'Cognotik Desktop – Plugin Installation' with fade-in-from-black.
Introduction: narrator explains the app is extensible and navigates to the Plugins page.
Upload Plugin: clicks Upload Plugin, Choose File, selects the JAR file.
Auto-load & Upload: checks auto-load option and uploads the plugin.
License & Patreon: accepts license agreement, verifies Patreon subscription. Time-compressed pauses maintain flow.
Allow & Refresh: clicks allow, closes dialog, refreshes home page to show new options.
Closing summary: 'plug-in installation is simple, and adds working applications.'
Outro billboard: 'Thanks for Watching!' with Patreon CTA, fade-to-black.
